content:
EkLavya Model Residential School (EMRS) has released the Tier-II Final Result for the recruitment of Teaching and Non-Teaching posts under the EMRS / NESTS recruitment cycle.

The recruitment process started through the 2025 notification, and the final result is now available on the official exam portal for shortlisted candidates.

Applicants are advised to check the result notice, scorecard and next-stage instructions on the official EMRS portal.
